# plugin-trust.json

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown plugin-trust.json`; do not edit -->

Location: $LETIBOT_PLUGIN_TRUST (empty = memory only), else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/plugin-trust.json, else ~/.config/letibot/plugin-trust.json

the plugin trust book: which layer directories run without asking, at which hashes

Written by: letibot, on /plugin trust, /plugin untrust, a kept rebuild and every tool write of a plugin file; merged under plugin-trust.lock. Unknown keys are dropped on save

## `[pins[]]`

A layer runs freely when its module and manifest hashes match an in-force pin for its dir.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | "" | manifest name when pinned |
| `dir` | string | required | canonical layer directory; the entry's identity |
| `module` | sha256 | "" | hash of the module file |
| `manifest` | sha256 | "" | hash of plugin.toml |
| `capabilities` | list \| null | null | capabilities when pinned; a rebuild keeps the pin only if unchanged |
| `at_ms` | int | 0 | time of the pin; the newest per dir wins |

## `[revoked[]]`

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dir` | string | required | layer directory that was un-pinned |
| `at_ms` | int | 0 | a pin counts only if newer |

## `[writes[]]`

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | plugin file a tool wrote |
| `sha256` | string | "" | hash of the bytes written |
| `at_ms` | int | 0 | time of the write |
| `session` | string | "" | session whose tool wrote it |
